ingredients.raw: 10 ounces ramen (millet & brown rice ramen recommended)
ingredients.name: ramen

ingredients.raw: 2 teaspoons grated ginger root (or 1 teaspoon ground ginger)
ingredients.name: ginger

instructions.text: Boil water and prepare ramen per package directions. Drain, rinse with cold water, and return to pot off heat. Toss with sesame oil to prevent sticking.
Combine coconut aminos, peanut butter, rice vinegar, sesame oil, sriracha, warm water, and ginger in a bowl or jar. Whisk or shake vigorously until smooth, about 45 seconds.
Add cooked noodles, edamame, cucumber, and green onion to a mixing bowl. Pour sauce over mixture and toss until evenly coated. Top with cilantro and mint.
Refrigerate until serving. Top each portion with sesame seeds and lime juice before eating.
